name: Bar Chart
summary: Bar Chart. A dense, readable data primitive with semantic structure and resilient overflow.

lifecycle.compatibility: Available for controlled production evaluation; the contract may still be refined.
lifecycle.rationale: The accessible mark-navigation and source-table contract remains beta while chart scale and manual assistive-technology evidence mature.
knownLimitations: The primitive does not yet provide grouped or stacked series, axes customization, or large-series virtualization.
Consumers must verify value formatting and mark density with production data.
promotionCriteria: Public API, defaults, aliases and entrypoint ownership are reviewed.
SSR/hydration, keyboard, accessibility and visual evidence are linked.
Runtime scale limits and consumer testing contract are documented.
Migration impact is classified before lifecycle promotion.

api.name: title
api.description: Visible title that also names the component surface or data view.

api.name: eyebrow
api.description: Human-readable copy for the eyebrow state or control.

api.name: description
api.description: Visible supporting description for the component content.

api.name: data
api.description: Immutable data supplied by the consumer.

api.name: palette
api.description: Ordered semantic color values available to the color control.

api.name: locale
api.description: Locale identifier used for collation, formatting, and component-owned copy.

api.name: labels
api.description: Localized copy overrides for the component-owned interface text.

api.name: valueFormatter
api.description: Formats a domain value for visible and accessible presentation.

api.name: percentFormatter
api.description: Formats a normalized value for visible and accessible percentage copy.

api.name: datumIdentity
api.description: Returns a stable unique key used to preserve DOM and active state across data reordering.

api.name: negativeValuePolicy
api.description: Clamps negative values to zero by default or rejects them with a validation error.

api.name: summaryItemLimit
api.description: Limits the accessible text summary while the full data table remains available.

keyboard: Tab reaches the source-data toggle, then the single roving data mark.
Arrow Left and Arrow Right move between marks and reverse in RTL.
Home and End move to the first and last mark; Enter or Space discloses its value.
notes: The chart has a specific title and a keyboard-operable data representation.
A semantic source-data table exposes the same labels and values.
Color is supplemented by labels, focus treatment, and the value detail.
KERN avoids ambient browser globals in reusable runtime infrastructure.
Validate the consuming SSR/hydration route, locale, ids and overlay host.

examples.title: Typed regional revenue bar chart

guidance.useWhen: Use Bar Chart to compare a small set of categorical values where a common baseline makes differences meaningful.
guidance.avoidWhen: Use Line Chart for ordered trends and a table when exact values or many categories dominate the task.

commonMistakes: Importing from an undeclared family path or a source implementation file.
Loading only tokens.css instead of the complete styles/kern.css component bundle.
Assuming the documentation SSR build replaces validation of the consuming application.
Keep datum labels unique and provide a title that explains the comparison.
checklist: Import the symbol from its documented owner entrypoint; do not use a deep source import.
Load @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css exactly once in the application's global styles.
Provide every required input and keep collection identities stable across updates.
Verify keyboard, focus, visible labels, invalid state, long text, RTL and 200% zoom.
Test the consuming SSR/hydration route when server rendering is enabled.
Use @kern-ui/angular/testing harnesses when a component-specific harness is available.
